Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the initial search results, which indicated tomatoes are the standard red ingredient in tabbouleh (a bulgur/wheat salad), and incorrectly concluded that pomegranate is the typical red fruit. This overgeneralization from an optional variation (pomegranate seeds) to the standard ingredient led to a wrong intermediate conclusion and misdirected subsequent instructions.
